title: Builder BLD-402: Vera collaborator

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-402.

detail:
B4 Together, pass BLD-402 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-402). Vera collaborator. Scope: components/builder/vera, lib/ai. Build: Vera joins as a client. Tools: read_page, plan_page, apply_edits, validate. Proposals show as ghosted diffs, accepted per section, one transaction each. Speaks first only at page creation; after that, only from ⌘K or her rail. Done when: Vera output names only tokens and known slot keys; Accept and undo are one step each. Gates: raw-css-paths ratchet, vitest suite (required test job), check:roles (new), Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-401, BLD-004. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Vera joins the builder shell as a client of the draft: read_page, plan_page (the layout action), validate and apply_edits in lib/builder/vera.ts. Her rail (⌘K, the Vera button or the Add sheet) lists a proposal grouped by section, each group can be ghosted on the canvas and accepted on its own as one edit, so one undo. She speaks first only on an empty page. Output is the closed token vocabulary of vera-layout, parsed again in the browser. BLD-401 presence stays blocked on the CRDT; this pass does not need it.
